en: Dependent on a state that is both a root and associated with a root, and on a state that is a root, there arises a state that is neither a root nor dissociated from a root and is not a root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ...

one under non-disappearance. Dependent on a state that is associated with a root but is not a root, and on a state that is not a root, there arises a state that is dissociated from a root but is not a root and is not not-a-root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance. (Abbreviated.)
